clause_text: Apparel is eligible for refund within 30 days when labels are attached and the item is unworn. Damaged packaging requires manager review.
Electronics returns require original serial number match intact factory seal for open-box refund and fraud review when accessories are missing.
VIP customers with high lifetime value may receive instant credit when return history is low and evidence supports carrier or product defect.
Customers with multiple high-value returns in a short window require denial or additional documentation when policy evidence is weak.
